title: 2024 Topps Update Chrome Xfractor Naoyuki Uwasawa Boston Red Sox RC USC9
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Topps Update Chrome Xfractor card features Naoyuki Uwasawa of the Boston Red Sox. The card is a rookie card and is part of the Chrome Update set. It is manufactured by Topps in the United States and is a sports trading card.

The card is a great addition to any collection for fans of the MLB and baseball in general. The X-Fractor parallel/variety adds a unique touch to the card and makes it a must-have for collectors who appreciate rare and special edition cards. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this piece of sports memorabilia.
